dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: "Adventure in Arianrhod"... That's the fairy tale the old man got me when I was a kid... Am I too old for something like that now?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Lately, though, while playing Tabletop Troupe with the others, I've noticed that several parts of the game's plot are quite similar to that book's story. I guess it might be popular in other nations?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I should re-read when I have the time. Maybe it'll help me the next time I play Tabletop Troupe.
